integrity: All central polynomial identities were replayed with exact rational arithmetic from the embedded checker. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Necessary conditions for compact recurrence are proved; existence or stability for a>b is not claimed.
The period bound concerns nonconstant periodic orbits only.
One same-object synchronization paper was accessible only through its abstract/index record during the comparison, and potentially unindexed older literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Compact-recurrence phase boundary and strict period floor in the generalized Sprott Q flow
